candidates.rationale: Child of bank_logistic_balanced exploring the default (unregularized-by-class-weight) logistic configuration; keeps the linear probability baseline for the imbalanced precontact bank target and the training-only pipeline, differing from the parent's balanced weighting.

Child of bank_logistic_balanced adding stronger regularization to the linear model, which can stabilize coefficients on the conservative precontact feature set and provide a complementary probability ranking for average_precision.
Child of bank_forest_balanced using default forest configuration to test whether unweighted tree averaging captures nonlinear precontact interactions differently from the balanced-weight parent.

Child of bank_forest_balanced with reduced depth to limit variance on the small precontact feature set, offering a lower-capacity tree alternative for candidate comparison under the ordered split protocol.
